Anthropic’s IPO filing is public: proposed Nasdaq ticker ANT, with pricing and share count still unset. The registration is not yet effective.

H1 2026 revenue was $16.3B and the net loss was $80.7B. But $72.4B came from revaluing convertible notes and other financing instruments...

images.alt: English infographic about Anthropic’s IPO. H1 2026: $16.3B revenue, $80.7B net loss including $72.4B in financing-instrument fair-value charges, and +$3.9B operating cash flow. Future SpaceXAI compute payments: up to $120.5B into 2029, about $3.1B monthly at full capacity; cancellable on 90 days’ notice after initial periods ending Jan/Mar 2027. Separately, an unnamed customer generated 34.5% of SpaceX’s Q3 2026 revenue; its filing does not identify that customer as Anthropic.
